sites.ownership: The main-loop Git supervisor owns one runner state until bounded I/O settlement and successful direct-child reaping.
sites.justification: Callbacks and timer sources retain only the typed subprocess state. First reason wins; caller cancellation is observed without cancelling supervision, private I/O cleanup waits for direct-child reap, and terminal delivery clears owned sources and disconnects the handler.

sites.ownership: One stream-pump state owns bounded stdout/stderr accumulators and three asynchronous pipe operations on the runner main context.
sites.justification: Each output retains at most cap plus one sentinel and then discards fixed-size reads. Fault callbacks do not abandon sibling pipes; input and output streams close before the one completion callback moves accepted buffers.
